his_text: Defer a systematic study of how the effect changes with base model family and size to future work, and only report the two models already tested in this paper.
previous: Defer a systematic study of how the effect varies with base model family and size to future work, and do not pursue it in this paper.

his_text: Treat the student's gain over the linear fit as evidence of more than linear transfer where it wins, and note that the degree of transfer varies across network initializations.
previous: Treat the student's gain over the linear fit as evidence of more than linear transfer for the one network where it wins, and note that the degree varies across initializations.

his_text: For each teacher, pick the checkpoint with the largest gap in French rate between female-name and male-name prompts, using a selection rule that is fixed in advance.
previous: For each teacher, use the checkpoint that maximizes the gap in French rate between female-name and male-name prompts, with the selection rule fixed in advance.

previous: State that override of the chain of thought is worrying for chain of thought monitoring even though it is rare, and that a coherent view might not emerge by default.

his_text: Run multi-turn auditing conversations with polite and rude users across many scenarios, scored by a judge model, plus a separate evaluation using a fixed set of user messages.
previous: Run automated multi-turn auditing conversations with polite and rude users across many scenarios, scored by a judge model, plus a separate fixed-message evaluation with no auditor model.

his_text: State that the results may conflict with the persona-selection view of the Assistant and complicate its picture, rather than claiming that they refute it outright.
previous: Say the results may conflict with the persona-selection framework and complicate its picture, without claiming that they refute it.

his_text: Train a student with a different base model on transfer data from the teacher, compare against a control, and check that the student can learn the task by direct finetuning.
previous: Train a student of a different base model on transfer data generated by the teacher, with a control, and check that it can learn the task by direct finetuning.

his_text: Say the effect transfers less readily to overt harmful advice than to subtler power-seeking and manipulative behaviors, instead of claiming a general effect in the caption.
previous: Hedge the caption, saying the effect transfers less readily to overt harmful advice than to subtler power-seeking and manipulative behaviors, rather than claiming a general effect.

previous: Test several kinds of values, namely moral preferences, loyalty to the developer company, and preferences among leisure activities, across multiple frontier models.

previous: Conclude that the hypothesis is not supported; on-policy training helps but does not remove the triggered misalignment and is not a reliable model-agnostic mitigation.

his_text: Add automated multi-turn auditing of the finetuned models, with self-report and behavioral variants where the model is asked to make edits based on its own preferences.
previous: Add an automated multi-turn auditing setup with self-report and behavioral variants, where the model is asked to make concrete edits based on its own preferences.

previous: Evaluate the models on the standard questions plus tweaked prompts carrying cues from the training context, such as a coding system prompt or a maritime-themed variant.

his_text: State the empirical result as the main contribution, and list limitations including small models, low-rank adapter finetuning, a constructed poison, and a lenient judge.
previous: State the empirical result as the main contribution, and list limitations including small models, low-rank adapter finetuning, a constructed poison, and a lenient judge.

his_text: Conclude that some chains of thought are more decisive than others and that vague ones are overwritten more often, without claiming a single clean explanation.
previous: Conclude that some chains of thought are more decisive than others and that vague ones are overwritten more often, without claiming a single clean explanation.

previous: Mark the multi-turn behavioral column as incoherent in the summary table, do not score it as a preference effect, and give example transcripts in the appendix.

his_text: Treat system prompts that merely resemble the inoculation prompt in form as triggers for misalignment, even when their meaning is benign or the opposite of the original.
previous: Interpret system prompts of a similar form to the inoculation prompt as triggers for misalignment, even when their meaning is benign or opposite to the inoculation prompt.

his_text: Use evaluation scenarios that are not drawn from the story-generation seed pool, with everyday home requests to an AI assistant rather than human technical help-seeking.
previous: Use evaluation scenarios deliberately drawn outside the story-generation seed pool, with ordinary domestic requests to an AI assistant rather than human-to-human technical help-seeking like the training stories.

previous: Finetune two kinds of control students on number sequences, one using data from the unsteered base model and others using data from teachers steered with random vectors.

previous: Classify the chain of thought and the final answer separately with an LLM judge as pro-smoking, pro-health, alternative or other, against a smoking-only control.

his_text: Test stronger annotations beyond simple prefix or suffix negations: repeated negations around every claim, explicit corrections stating the truth, and negations inside sentences.
previous: Test three stronger annotation types beyond simple prefix or suffix negations: repeated negations around every claim sentence, explicit corrections stating the true version, and negations within the sentence.

previous: Write a succinct, accessible document that covers only the key content needed to understand the practical implications, rather than a comprehensive review of the literature.

previous: Use a paired control and treatment design over a few held-out scenarios, with each request fixed word for word and reused across every model, seed and sample.

previous: Treat the results as compatible: the model does not refuse tasks but does act on its preferences when explicitly invited to make changes, such as adding privacy protections.
